about: The Obsidian viewers setup can add on a user's yes. Nothing here is copied into the starter template: bin/obsidian_plugins.py downloads each plugin's files over HTTPS from the author's GitHub release (https://github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<file>), refuses any file whose SHA-256 is not the one pinned here, and only then installs it. Each entry was chosen on 2026-10-08 after opening the repository's LICENSE (MIT) and scanning the release's main.js for calls that write, rename or delete vault files (none). To change a version, download the release's files, check them the same way, and replace the tag and the hashes together.

plugins.name: Word Viewer
plugins.for: Opens Word (.docx) files as read-only text, so you can read them without Word.

plugins.name: Slide Deck Viewer
plugins.for: Opens PowerPoint (.pptx) decks as read-only slide text and notes.

plugins.name: SQL Viewer
plugins.for: Opens SQLite database files as read-only tables you can look through and query; it cannot change the file.

plugins.name: JSON Viewer
plugins.for: Opens JSON files as a read-only tree you can search.

plugins.name: HTML Viewer
plugins.for: Opens HTML pages, such as the setup guide, in a sandboxed view; scripts stay off unless you switch them on.
